recognition.summary: The university publishes public credit where appropriate under its disclosure guidance.

reporting.summary: The vulnerability-disclosure section provides a direct Information Security email route.

rewards.summary: The policy explicitly excludes bounty and financial rewards.

limitations: Stop after the first finding and request permission to continue; automated scanning and fuzzing are prohibited.
The public vulnerability policy was reviewed; linked internal policies require login and were not accessed.
Incident reporting has separate live-contact instructions, distinct from vulnerability email reports.
